guidance.TrialEnding: Trial access is ending soon. Start a paid plan before the deadline to keep trading active.
guidance.PaidRenewalDue: Paid subscription coverage is ending soon. Renew before the deadline to keep trading uninterrupted.
guidance.PaidTermCancelled: This subscription is scheduled to end at the current deadline without automatic continuation.
guidance.GraceActive: This shop is in its grace period. Renew before grace expires to avoid trading restrictions.
guidance.GraceEnding: Grace period ends soon. Renew immediately to avoid trading restrictions.
guidance.AccessExpired: Subscription access has expired. Contact the billing owner to restore coverage.
guidance.SuspendedNoPaymentLift: Access is suspended. Payment alone does not lift a suspension; contact support.
guidance.TrialEndingPartialSuspension: Trial access is ending soon for active shops on this account. At least one covered shop is suspended; payment alone does not lift a suspension.
guidance.PaidRenewalPartialSuspension: Paid subscription coverage is ending soon for active shops on this account. At least one covered shop is suspended; renewing does not lift a suspension.
guidance.GraceActivePartialSuspension: Grace period is active for eligible covered shops. At least one covered shop is suspended; renewing does not lift a suspension.
guidance.GraceEndingPartialSuspension: Grace period ends soon for eligible covered shops. At least one covered shop is suspended; renewing does not lift a suspension.

operationalGuidance.TrialEnding: This shop's trial access is ending soon. Contact the account billing owner or manager before trading is restricted.
operationalGuidance.PaidRenewalDue: Paid subscription coverage for this shop is ending soon. Contact the account billing owner or manager before the deadline.
operationalGuidance.PaidTermCancelled: This shop's subscription is scheduled to end at the current deadline. Contact the account billing owner or manager if trading should continue.
operationalGuidance.GraceActive: This shop is in its grace period. Contact the account billing owner or manager before the grace deadline to avoid trading restrictions.
operationalGuidance.GraceEnding: This shop's grace period ends soon. Contact the account billing owner or manager immediately before trading is restricted.
operationalGuidance.AccessExpired: Subscription access for this shop has expired. Contact the account billing owner or manager to restore trading access.
operationalGuidance.SuspendedNoPaymentLift: Access for this shop is suspended. Payment alone does not lift a suspension; contact the account billing owner or support.

suspensionNoLift: Making a payment does not lift an active suspension.
